item.title: Alnylam/Inceptive Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Alnylam has partnered with AI startup Inceptive to advance RNA research and development. The deal includes $30 million upfront to leverage Inceptive's AI foundation models for RNA design, potentially accelerating Alnylam's pipeline.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Regeneron/Cytomx Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Regeneron has deepened its partnership with CytomX Therapeutics with a $37 million upfront payment and up to $2 billion in biobucks. The expanded deal covers the development of next-generation Probody therapeutics, despite other pharma companies stepping away from similar agreements.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech, BioPharma Dive

item.title: Lilly/Ascidian RNA Editing Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly has entered a deal with Ascidian Therapeutics worth up to $1.9 billion to develop RNA exon editors for kidney diseases. The collaboration applies Ascidian's RNA editing platform to targets selected by Lilly, with the potential to treat multiple kidney conditions.
  • MoAs: RNA exon editing: Uses synthetic RNA molecules to correct splicing errors and restore normal protein function without altering DNA.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Endpoints News, BioPharma Dive

item.title: NewLimit Age Reversal
item.description:
• Summary: NewLimit secured $435 million in financing after demonstrating age reversal effects in human liver cells. The company, co-founded by Patrick Collison and David Sinclair, is developing epigenetic reprogramming approaches to combat aging-related diseases.
  • MoAs: N/A (no specific drug named; platform based on epigenetic reprogramming)
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Axsome Patent Extension
item.description:
• Summary: Axsome Therapeutics secured a patent extension for its narcolepsy drug Sunosi (solriamfetol), pushing generic competition back until at least 2040. The move protects a key revenue driver from early generic erosion.
  • MoAs: Solriamfetol (Sunosi): Dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (DNRI) that promotes wakefulness in narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea.
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Bristol Myers AI Costs
item.description:
• Summary: Bristol Myers Squibb is turning its focus to managing artificial intelligence costs after a broad rollout of AI tools across its workforce. The company aims to optimize efficiency while controlling spending on the technology.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Travere Rare Kidney Disease Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Travere Therapeutics announced a deal worth up to $1.1 billion to expand its rare kidney disease portfolio through a partnership with a Chinese company. The deal includes an upfront payment and milestones for rights to a candidate in Asia, aiming to strengthen Travere's pipeline in rare kidney diseases such as IgA nephropathy.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Cencora/Gilead CAR-T Network
item.description:
• Summary: Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen) and Gilead Sciences are expanding their CAR-T treatment center network to improve patient access to cell therapies. The collaboration focuses on streamlining logistics and support for authorized treatment centers across the US.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Lilly/Boehringer Germany Investment
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly and Boehringer Ingelheim are reportedly planning to reduce their investments in Germany, citing changing market conditions and regulatory pressures. The decision could impact manufacturing and R&D operations in the country.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma
